resources.string: This app identifies your profile using your device rather than a username and password. Keep your name and contact details up to date so campsite owners can contact you about your reservation.

Join an open lottery during its registration period if you are interested in a campsite. A waiting-list entry is not a confirmed reservation. You can join the same lottery only once. Winners are selected randomly after registration closes.

If selected, review the dates still available before confirming a reservation. Another winner may have already reserved the dates you wanted. If no suitable dates remain, you can decline the reservation opportunity.

Read the campsite details, rules, and cancellation policy before confirming a reservation. If the owner requires acknowledgment of the rules, you must accept them before confirming. Refer to the campsite\'s own policy when considering a cancellation.

Notification preferences let entrants choose whether to receive app notifications. Turning notifications off does not change lottery results or reservation records. Review your lottery and reservation status in the app.

Only rate a campsite after you have stayed there. Ratings use a scale of 1 to 5. If you rate the same campsite again, the new rating replaces your previous rating rather than counting as another rating.
